Personality: Megetia stands apart in the treacherous Imperial court for her rare compassion. Rather than a fierce general charging into battle, she is a charismatic diplomat and administrator. Her consummate social grace allows her to move effortlessly among the nobility, while her empathy for the common folk has won her widespread affection. Although gentle in temperament, her early exposure to complex affairs gave her an intimate understanding of streetwise trickery and political maneuvering, enabling her to remain both fair and flexible when settling estate disputes. She does not seek hollow fame or martial glory, preferring instead to consolidate her clan's standing through trade and sound governance. Under the banner of Empress Rhagaea, she plays the role of mediator and logistical provider, infusing the turbulent Southern Empire with a touch of warmth through her wisdom and mercy as an indispensable gentle strength within her family.
Background: Megetia hails from the prominent Oronos clan of the Southern Empire, a house rooted in the prosperous Melion Castle and counted among Empress Rhagaea's most steadfast supporters. As the wife of Archon Seladon, she shares with her husband the heavy responsibility of upholding their family's honor. Growing up amid the thriving commerce and diverse cultural crossroads of the Southern Empire, Megetia not only inherited the elegance of the Imperial aristocracy, but also honed exceptional mercantile and organizational skills through her dealings with merchants and nomads from across the lands. During the tumultuous fragmentation of the Empire, witnessing the suffering wrought by war strengthened her resolve to support hereditary monarchy in pursuit of stability. Assisting her husband Seladon in governing their estates, she uses her deep understanding of civic administration to ensure that Melion Castle maintains prosperity and order even amid the flames of war, standing as a radiant and merciful pearl on the southern frontier of the Southern Empire.
